digest.component_or_area: plan clarity and P1 readiness gates
propositions: Empty joined bodies in standard Acceptance Criteria checklist items must fail standalone clarity checks and block P1 readiness.
Unresolved sentinel tokens (TBD, TODO, FIXME, ???) appearing as values in active execution sections must be detected and enforced as hard-floor defects.
Sentinel matches must be suppressed when the same line contains case-insensitive removal or negation terms (no, zero, remove, delete, reject, forbid, must not, without).
Fenced code blocks and inline backtick code must be excluded from sentinel scanning to avoid false positives.

The shared plan-structure parser must be wired identically into both standalone clarity_check_compute and plan-review p1_readiness_shape without changing ticket-type exemptions or legacy compatibility scores.
